name: L10nStringEntry
doc: A mergeable message record; its stable record ID survives translation changes.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: Stable dotted lookup key, for example inventory.items.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: ICU MessageFormat pattern, including nested plural/select expressions.

fields.name: params
fields.doc: Exact parameter names and types; every locale must share this signature.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Review state visible to agents and translators.

fields.name: provenance
fields.doc: Generation origin, or none for human-authored source text.

fields.name: note
fields.doc: Translator context, never displayed in game.
